chose: The deploy fetches main and applies the release from a worktree of the commit that carries it (/var/lib/home-deploy/releases/<sha>), so compose, the deploy/<role>/ names and the image digests move as one commit; the owner's own checkout is never touched.
options: never update anything on home but images (C82)
run each release from its own worktree of main
gray: C82 kept main's compose and sops changes off home unreviewed. Every release is now a merged main commit whose CI checked the set, and the owner's checkout is left alone, so C82's reason holds while its rule moves. Home now does a git fetch on a demanded pass.
undo: Run compose from the owner's checkout again and read release.json there; an image that needs a newer checkout then fails its preflight as under C82.
